exceptions.rationale: Reviewed frontend e5322a16ed71c08f0aa07f882e059e3536ff1975: braces 3.0.3 is dev-only through Lingui/micromatch and static-copy/chokidar. Lingui uses static repository patterns with filenames as data through picomatch; static-copy watches literal repository targets, never request paths or filenames as brace patterns. No untrusted brace-pattern input reaches braces; vulnerable executable code is absent from the Nginx runtime (retained SBOM metadata is not code). Before renewal, recheck published fixes, dependency topology, reachability and runtime contents; prefer dependency remediation.

Independently revalidated Android 63d9ed67dec7bf28814025a193a7cd4206717f2c and its frontend pin 8c950220d8ae582a536135eed75c8ecb2a4858c8 on 2026-10-13. The 9782-byte asset rebuilds identically; its 198 static alpha-2 country codes match src/lib/iso3166CountryOptions.ts blob b3e8f72d92d280ffc1f0f3a569ea1c33cc23ccca. The pinned Trivy 0.74.0 SendGrid detector matches only the dot-separated country literal, with no credential, environment value or dynamic interpolation. Fresh three-class action replay retains exactly this finding. Bounded five-day review window for Android adoption; before renewal independently recheck source lineage, exact blob, scanner necessity and static-data classification. Changed asset bytes require separate review.
